description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called StatusLiveRegion that provides an accessible live region announcing the current game status (whose turn, winner, or draw) in a Tic Tac Toe game. It listens to the GameState model via Provider to update dynamically.

classes.name: StatusLiveRegion
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that displays an accessible live region announcing the current game status for screen readers.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, creating a Semantics widget with live region properties that updates based on GameState.

methods.name: _status
methods.description: Determines the current game status string ('Draw', 'Winner: ...', or 'Turn: ...') based on GameState.
